per_depth.common_affordance: The component universe has only k ≤ 22 indexed choices, so used-component sets can be represented and searched with bitmasks or subset states.
The requirements reduce the task to choosing exactly one pathway for each input while enforcing that output ports and frequencies are also pairwise distinct.
Selecting exactly k triples with no repeated coordinate in any of the three k-sized dimensions is a three-dimensional matching that can be searched by assigning one triple to each input port.
